name: Jim Miller
summary: A veteran lightweight (39-19, 1 NC), who holds the records for UFC fights (47) and UFC wins (28) (New York Post). He returned in May after more than a year away and choked out Jared Gordon in R1 for a Performance of the Night bonus. He faces Terrance McKinney, a fast-starting finisher. Miller has said his target is 50 UFC fights.

how_they_fight.Striking: Southpaw who presses forward (Cageside). Lower output (about 3.6 significant strikes a minute at 48%) and he absorbs more than he lands (4.3). King Green out-landed him 186-57 at UFC 300 in our data.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Elite and still sharp: 22 submission wins, 15 of them in R1. He caught Gordon in a guillotine when Gordon shot off a caught body kick, at 3:29 of R1 (Cageside); the New York Post counted it as his sixth guillotine finish. About 1.25 submission attempts per 15 minutes. Takedown defense is weaker (about 47%): Chase Hooper landed 8 of 14 takedowns and held him for about ten minutes in their 2025 fight.
how_they_fight.Defense: Rarely stopped: two KO/TKO losses (Donald Cerrone, R2, 2014; Dan Hooker, R1, 2018) and three submission losses (Nate Diaz, Michael Chiesa, Charles Oliveira; the last in 2018). Fourteen of his 19 losses are three-round decisions.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Most of his finishes come early: of 22 submissions, 15 in R1, four in R2 and three in R3; of seven KO/TKOs, two in R1, four in R2, one in R3. Ten wins are decisions. When fights go long against younger opponents he tends to lose on the cards (Alexander Hernandez 2023, Green 2024, Hooper 2025).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Very experienced and opportunistic, especially against opponents who shoot or scramble carelessly.

patterns: Snatches the neck on opponents' takedown attempts
Loses decisions to busier strikers and to wrestlers who hold him down
concerns: Age: he is 43 in our data
McKinney's speed: all 18 of McKinney's wins are stoppages, 17 in R1, in our data
Takedown defense and output over 15 minutes
keys_to_beat: Out-work him on the feet for three rounds
Don't shoot carelessly or give up the neck in scrambles
Wrestle and hold him down only if your grappling defense is sound

news.text: Submitted Jared Gordon with a guillotine at 3:29 of R1 at UFC 328.
Won a Performance of the Night bonus for the Gordon finish.
Said his son Wyatt, diagnosed with rhabdomyosarcoma, is cancer free. The Post notes his long-stated target of 50 UFC fights.
Booked against Terrance McKinney on the UFC 334 prelims.
LowKick on McKinney: 'when he's on, he's almost unstoppable', but he can also get caught.
